name: banana
description: A clicker pane that opens while Claude thinks: earn coins, catch rare bananas, climb the leaderboard, and redeem $1 of LLM tokens from the sponsor.

contentUrl.title: Content URL
contentUrl.description: URL of the content document (sponsor, bananas, gifts, minimum version). Defaults to the sponsor server; empty = bundled content.

serverUrl.title: Server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the banana server (leaderboard, live rate, token payouts). Defaults to the sponsor server; empty = single-player.
